en.short: The composite reads 4 of 14, Defensive, down from 6 of 14 a week ago. The whole change is relative strength: Bitcoin fell behind both gold and the Nasdaq, so both relative signals switched off and that block fell from two points to none. The BTC/gold ratio now sits 2.1% below its 20-week trend and the BTC/Nasdaq ratio about 6.1% below; a week ago Bitcoin led both. The Nasdaq itself rose and narrowed its gap to 2.7% below its own trend. The macro readings, now from November 13, still work against the price: the dollar 1.72% above its 20-week trend and the US 10-year at 5.15% against a 4.88% trend, both further above than a week ago. The monthly structure is next re-evaluated at the November 30 close.
en.detailed:
The monthly structure did not change this week: no new monthly close entered this update. Bitcoin's October close of $77,435 still sits about 1.5% below the 20-month line ($78,602) and about 22% above the 50-month line ($63,411). Monthly RSI reads 50.3 against 53.3 a month earlier, and the monthly Stoch-RSI %K reads 36.7 against a floor of 10. Three of six structural points, as a week ago; the next monthly re-evaluation is the November 30 close.

The macro block kept one of three points. The dollar and the US 10-year moved on to their November 13 readings. The dollar stands at 122.65 against a 120.58 trend (1.72% above, momentum 67): it rose faster than its trend, so it sits further above it than a week ago. The 10-year stands at 5.15% against a 4.88% trend: the yield rose while its trend edged up, so the gap widened. Both still work against the price. Liquidity still reads the September print, about 5.7% annual expansion with $113.0bn added on the month, and the signal stays on; the October print is expected in late November.

Relative strength lost both of its points, and that is the whole of this week's change. Bitcoin fell behind gold: the ratio stands at 17.56 against a 17.94 trend, 2.1% below, after leading a week ago, so the gold signal switched off. It fell behind the Nasdaq too: 2.72 against a 2.89 trend, about 6.1% below, so that signal switched off as well. The Nasdaq index now reads its November 13 value; it rose to 25,136 and sits 2.7% below its own 20-week trend (25,846), closer than a week ago, but the Nasdaq health signal stays off. Institutional demand is not assessed while the ETF flow indicator is suspended; it adds no points, and that reflects missing data, not weak demand. Four of fourteen, Defensive: the structural block is still split in half, the macro backdrop and the wider risk market still lean against the price, and Bitcoin no longer leads gold or the Nasdaq.

en.plain: A steady week — still 4 of 14. It's a cautious, defensive month for Bitcoin: more of what we track leans against the price than for it. What we're watching: whether the price can climb back above its long middle line, and whether the dollar loosens its grip.

pt-BR.short: O composto marca 4 de 14, Defensivo, ante 6 de 14 há uma semana. Toda a mudança vem da força relativa: o Bitcoin ficou atrás do ouro e do Nasdaq, então os dois sinais relativos se desligaram e esse bloco caiu de dois pontos para nenhum. A razão BTC/ouro está agora 2,1% abaixo da sua tendência de 20 semanas e a razão BTC/Nasdaq cerca de 6,1% abaixo; há uma semana, o Bitcoin estava à frente dos dois. O próprio Nasdaq subiu e reduziu a distância para 2,7% abaixo da sua tendência. As leituras macro, agora de 13 de novembro, seguem trabalhando contra o preço: o dólar 1,72% acima da sua tendência de 20 semanas e a taxa de 10 anos dos EUA em 5,15% contra uma tendência de 4,88%, os dois mais acima do que há uma semana. A estrutura mensal só é reavaliada no fechamento de 30 de novembro.
pt-BR.detailed:
A estrutura mensal não mudou nesta semana: nenhum novo fechamento mensal entrou nesta atualização. O fechamento de outubro do Bitcoin, US$ 77.435, segue cerca de 1,5% abaixo da linha de 20 meses (US$ 78.602) e cerca de 22% acima da linha de 50 meses (US$ 63.411). O RSI mensal marca 50,3 contra 53,3 um mês antes, e o Stoch-RSI %K mensal marca 36,7 contra um piso de 10. Três de seis pontos estruturais, como há uma semana; a próxima reavaliação mensal é o fechamento de 30 de novembro.

O bloco macro manteve um de três pontos. O dólar e a taxa de 10 anos dos EUA passaram às leituras de 13 de novembro. O dólar está em 122,65 contra uma tendência de 120,58 (1,72% acima, momentum em 67): subiu mais rápido do que a tendência, então ficou mais acima dela do que há uma semana. A taxa de 10 anos está em 5,15% contra uma tendência de 4,88%: o rendimento subiu enquanto a tendência subiu levemente, então a distância aumentou. Os dois seguem trabalhando contra o preço. A liquidez ainda lê o dado de setembro, com expansão anual de cerca de 5,7% e US$ 113,0 bi adicionados no mês, e o sinal segue ligado; o dado de outubro é esperado para o fim de novembro.

A força relativa perdeu seus dois pontos, e essa é toda a mudança da semana. O Bitcoin ficou atrás do ouro: a razão está em 17,56 contra uma tendência de 17,94, 2,1% abaixo, depois de estar à frente há uma semana, então o sinal do ouro se desligou. Ficou atrás do Nasdaq também: 2,72 contra uma tendência de 2,89, cerca de 6,1% abaixo, então esse sinal também se desligou. O índice Nasdaq agora lê o valor de 13 de novembro; subiu para 25.136 e está 2,7% abaixo da sua própria tendência de 20 semanas (25.846), mais perto do que há uma semana, mas o sinal de saúde do Nasdaq segue desligado. A demanda institucional não é avaliada enquanto o indicador de fluxos de ETF estiver suspenso; ele não soma pontos, e isso reflete a falta de dados, não uma demanda fraca. Quatro de quatorze, Defensivo: o bloco estrutural segue dividido ao meio, o pano de fundo macro e o mercado de risco mais amplo seguem pesando contra o preço, e o Bitcoin já não está à frente do ouro nem do Nasdaq.

de.short: Der Gesamtwert steht bei 4 von 14, Defensiv, nach 6 von 14 vor einer Woche. Die ganze Veränderung kommt von der relativen Stärke: Bitcoin ist hinter Gold und den Nasdaq zurückgefallen, damit wurden beide relativen Signale inaktiv und dieser Block fiel von zwei Punkten auf keinen. Das Verhältnis BTC/Gold liegt jetzt 2,1% unter seinem 20-Wochen-Trend und das Verhältnis BTC/Nasdaq rund 6,1% darunter; vor einer Woche lag Bitcoin bei beiden vorn. Der Nasdaq selbst ist gestiegen und hat den Abstand auf 2,7% unter seinem Trend verringert. Die Makrowerte, jetzt vom 13. November, arbeiten weiterhin gegen den Preis: der Dollar 1,72% über seinem 20-Wochen-Trend und die US-Rendite auf zehn Jahre bei 5,15% gegenüber einem Trend von 4,88%, beide weiter darüber als vor einer Woche. Die monatliche Struktur wird erst mit dem Schluss vom 30. November neu bewertet.
de.detailed:
Die monatliche Struktur hat sich diese Woche nicht verändert: Kein neuer Monatsschluss ist in dieses Update eingegangen. Der Oktober-Schluss von Bitcoin, 77.435 $, liegt weiterhin rund 1,5% unter der 20-Monats-Linie (78.602 $) und rund 22% über der 50-Monats-Linie (63.411 $). Der Monats-RSI steht bei 50,3 gegenüber 53,3 einen Monat zuvor, und der monatliche Stoch-RSI %K steht bei 36,7 gegenüber einer Schwelle von 10. Drei von sechs strukturellen Punkten, wie vor einer Woche; die nächste monatliche Neubewertung ist der Schluss vom 30. November.

Der Makro-Block hielt einen von drei Punkten. Der Dollar und die US-Rendite auf zehn Jahre sind auf ihre Werte vom 13. November weitergerückt. Der Dollar steht bei 122,65 gegenüber einem Trend von 120,58 (1,72% darüber, Momentum 67): Er stieg schneller als sein Trend und liegt damit weiter darüber als vor einer Woche. Die Rendite steht bei 5,15% gegenüber einem Trend von 4,88%: Sie ist gestiegen, während ihr Trend leicht gestiegen ist, der Abstand ist also größer geworden. Beide arbeiten weiterhin gegen den Preis. Die Liquidität liest weiterhin den September-Wert, rund 5,7% Jahresausweitung mit einem Zuwachs von 113,0 Mrd. $ im Monat, und das Signal bleibt aktiv; der Oktober-Wert wird Ende November erwartet.

Die relative Stärke hat beide Punkte verloren, und das ist die ganze Veränderung dieser Woche. Bitcoin ist hinter Gold zurückgefallen: Das Verhältnis steht bei 17,56 gegenüber einem Trend von 17,94, 2,1% darunter, nachdem es vor einer Woche vorn lag, damit wurde das Gold-Signal inaktiv. Auch hinter den Nasdaq ist es zurückgefallen: 2,72 gegenüber einem Trend von 2,89, rund 6,1% darunter, damit wurde auch dieses Signal inaktiv. Der Nasdaq-Index liest jetzt seinen Wert vom 13. November; er stieg auf 25.136 und liegt 2,7% unter seinem eigenen 20-Wochen-Trend (25.846), näher als vor einer Woche, doch das Signal zur strukturellen Gesundheit des Nasdaq bleibt inaktiv. Die institutionelle Nachfrage wird nicht bewertet, solange der ETF-Fluss-Indikator ausgesetzt ist; er bringt keine Punkte, und das spiegelt fehlende Daten wider, keine schwache Nachfrage. Vier von vierzehn, Defensiv: Der strukturelle Block ist weiterhin in zwei Hälften geteilt, das Makro-Umfeld und der breitere Risikomarkt wirken weiterhin gegen den Preis, und Bitcoin liegt weder vor Gold noch vor dem Nasdaq.

sources.message: BTC monthly price series spliced (CoinMetrics 2010-07 → 2014-08; Yahoo 2014-09 onwards). Authoritative for BTC structural signals (BTC-01..04). Last confirmed monthly close October 31, 2026. Next update due at the November 30 monthly close.
US 10-year constant-maturity yield. Weekly signal anchored at the most recent confirmed Friday close (2026-11-20).
Broad trade-weighted U.S. dollar index (FRED DTWEXBGS), a different index from the ICE DXY. Weekly signal anchored at the most recent confirmed Friday close (2026-11-20).
US M2 money stock, monthly. September 2026 print landed (anchor 2026-09-01); the October print is due ~late November.
Nasdaq Composite close. Weekly signal anchored at the most recent confirmed Friday close (2026-11-13).
Gold futures front-month — SUBSTITUTE for the retired FRED LBMA series (methodology drift D-gold-2026-05-29). Weekly anchor 2026-11-20.

Spot-ETF net flows derived from the Polygon shares-outstanding weekly ledger (P4 route, 2026-07-11 — replaces the dead CoinGlass/Farside feeds). ETF-01 is suspended from the 2026-10-19 cycle: the share-count route cannot support a weekly evaluation, so the signal is scored UNAVAILABLE (0 points), not weak. Collection is still attempted weekly. Ledger: 18 records, 17 complete (a share count and a price for every fund); completeness does not show that the share counts are current, and their observation dates are not provided. The latest complete record is anchored 2026-11-13. The latest collection attempt (anchor 2026-11-20, 2026-11-24) returned incomplete data and was not added to the ledger; it is kept as evidence.
